description: Trigger discrimination for mobile journey QA design: critical journeys with mobile-specific checks versus layout correctness (mobile-viewport-craft), live walkthrough execution (clickthrough-test-engineer, manual-only), permanent E2E spec implementation (playwright-e2e-engineer, manual-only), and the general per-change plan (test-plan-designer).

cases.prompt: Which critical journeys should we verify on phones, and what touch, dialog and navigation checks does each need?
cases.reason: Critical-journey mobile checks (touch, dialogs, navigation) are journey QA design; layout fitting is mobile-viewport-craft and no per-change plan is in view.

cases.prompt: Our 100vh layout breaks on small phones — design the responsive layout so it fits every viewport.
cases.reason: Fitting the layout to phone viewports is mobile-viewport-craft's correctness design; this skill checks journeys across breakpoints, it does not fix the layout.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke clickthrough-test-engineer. Walk the checkout journey on a real phone and report the defects you find.
cases.reason: Executing a live clickthrough on a device is clickthrough-test-engineer (manual-only); this skill designs the coverage and drives nothing.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke playwright-e2e-engineer. Write Playwright specs for the mobile checkout journey with the iPhone viewport.
cases.reason: Implementing permanent E2E specs is playwright-e2e-engineer (manual-only); this skill designs which journeys and checks the specs must cover.

cases.prompt: Plan the testing for the new payment change across layers.
cases.reason: A general per-change plan with layers and exit criteria is test-plan-designer; mobile journey coverage is one slice a plan may name.

cases.prompt: Our checkout works on desktop but breaks on a 320px phone. Design the mobile journey checks that catch what breaks.
cases.reason: Designing the journey checks that expose phone-only breakage is this skill's core; fixing the layout is mobile-viewport-craft and writing the specs is playwright-e2e-engineer.
